qa_pair.question: How many notebooks are currently open (not closed) in this SiYuan workspace?
Across all open notebooks, how many documents (blocks of type 'd') exist in total?
Using full-text search for the keyword "template", how many heading blocks (type 'h') mention it? Report the integer count of matched heading blocks.
Find the document whose human-readable path is most deeply nested (the most '/' separators in its hpath). What is that document's title?
In the document titled "Please Start Here" from the SiYuan User Guide, how many top-level headings appear in its outline?
Identify the document that has the largest number of backlinks pointing to it. How many backlinks does it have?
Using SQL, find the most recently updated document (type 'd') across all notebooks. What is its title (content field)?
How many blocks in total carry at least one custom attribute (an attribute whose name starts with 'custom-')? Use SQL against the attributes table.
Read the full content of the SiYuan User Guide's first document. How many fenced code blocks (lines beginning with ```) does its Markdown contain?
Among all documents, which notebook contains the highest number of documents? Report the notebook's name.
